اغتفرا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَفَرَا (iḡtafarā) /iɣ.ta.fa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اُغْتُفِرَا (uḡtufirā) /uɣ.tu.fi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اِغْتَفِرَا (iḡtafirā) /iɣ.ta.fi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
